text:
sam: opened a small PR to refresh the quickstart onboarding flow. Goals: move examples to SDK8 async, drop the old .rw_token pattern, and fix a couple of portability nits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420
riley: sweet. can you call out the snippet diffs in the PR desc so reviewers know where to focus?
sam: done in the PR: python sync -> async, node top-level await + CJS fallback, replace `sed -i` with cross-platform node/python one-liners, canonicalize curl header to `"Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>"`, and align Docker EXPOSE with app port.
bot-ci: CI triggered for PR #1420  running build, linkcheck, snippet-tests.
tara: quick catch: curl example still lowercased the header in one spot. also the Dockerfile EXPOSE is 3000 but the sample app listens on 8080.
sam: fixing both now, pushing commit.
bot-ci: snippet-tests failing on macos runner: setup snippet uses `sed -i` -> log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1420/snippet-log
riley: prefer offering both options: a Node one-liner and a Python one-liner, label them "cross-platform". example: `node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('cfg',fs.readFileSync('cfg.tpl','utf8').replace('PLACEHOLDER',process.env.RW_API_KEY||''))"` and `python3 - <<'PY'
import os
open('cfg','w').write(open('cfg.tpl').read().replace('PLACEHOLDER',os.getenv('RW_API_KEY','')))
PY`
devex: also add a short troubleshooting FAQ: two bullets - missing header vs expired/ephemeral key. reduces support noise.
sam: added both snippets, added FAQ, and a one-line ephemeral-key example: `export RW_API_KEY=$(curl -s "https://auth.redwood.local/ephemeral?scope=generate")` plus a single-sentence TTL note. also linked to /security/kms for rotation/HSM. pushed.
bot-ci: rerunning snippet-tests.
bot-ci: all checks passed for PR #1420. mergeable.
tara: i'll sanity-check staging after deploy. if nothing else, :shipit:
bot-ci: site build and deploy to staging completed for PR 1420.
tara: verified staging quickstart end-to-end: auth examples run, Docker note fixed, ephemeral example works locally. tiny wording tweak on TTL that I pushed to the staging branch.
sam: thanks for the quick reviews and fixes everyone 389 closing thread after merge.
